method: Existing front leg pixels and source joints are reflected together using flipX. Physical limb identity, sockets, phase, IK link lengths and vertical foot contact are preserved.
visualReview: Root compared b040 original, exchanged source legs and mirrored source legs. Independent art reviewer inspected the final eight front poses of every listed boss against the original boards: outward feet, continuous knees/ankles, no unnatural foot overlap or clipping.
excluded: Already outward b020/b121, b050/b151, b050-2/b151-2; near-straight b010/b111/b111-2 and b030/b131; quadrupeds and flyers.
scope: Baked front-pose visual approval. Actual game checks and release file hashes are recorded separately.
